newsitem.title: USA: Zoltek Cos Q2 March 31 net hits a record.
newsitem.headline: Zoltek Cos Q2 March 31 net hits a record.

text.p: Zoltec Cos Inc said Thursday its earnings and sales in the second quarter ended March 31 set new records as its margins also increased.

The company reported net income of $3.1 million, or $0.19 a share, in the period compared to $1.2 million, or $0.09, one year ago. Sales rose to $22.9 million from $18.9 million posted in the first quarter of 1996.

Zoltec said the strong results reflect improved margins in both its carbon fibers business and at its Hungarian-based subsidiary. The company said it is on track to add a total of five million pounds of new annual capacity by the end of 1997, which will help Zoltec move to a faster rate of growth.
Zoltec produces carbon fibers used to reinforce composites. Its shares closed up 2-1/4 Thursday at 24-1/2.
